summary: Iter 15 Co-Parent / Family Group system: backend pytest 29/29 PASS (auto-migration, families CRUD, invites lifecycle, role enforcement viewer-write-block, ownership transfer, leave/delete guards, cancel invite, multi-family game-pack visibility, regression streak/missions/moments/students/audit). Frontend Playwright covered: parent navbar family switcher + dropdown + manage link, /family page render (name, Owner chip, 4 members with name+email+role+select, invite form, pending invites list), invite create -> link card + token, logged-out invite preview + sign-in CTA, wrong-email guard (Accept button hidden), student does NOT see switcher, rename UI works. One UX nit: when the active family has students+members, the Danger Zone is hidden (correct per delete preconditions) — testid `family-danger-zone` is therefore not present in that state, which matches business logic. Cleaned up all TEST_ data in demo family after testing.

issues: family-name-display briefly shows 'Loading…' immediately after navigation from navbar manage link; consider a small skeleton placeholder for the members list to avoid the 'empty for a beat' flash.

action_items: Optional UX polish: add a skeleton/loading state for FamilySettings members section to avoid the 'Loading…' flash.

Consider returning 400 (per spec) instead of 403 for 'Owner cannot remove themselves' DELETE /api/families/{id}/members/{owner_id} — currently returns 403 because _assert_family_owner check fires before the self-remove guard (test accepts both).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py remove_family_member: 'Owner cannot remove themselves' branch checks user_id == user['id'] AFTER _assert_family_owner; if the spec calls for HTTP 400 distinctly from non-owner 403, swap the order so the self-remove check runs first when the caller IS the owner.
server.py invite duplicate detection: confirmed that creating two pending invites for the same email returns 400 'pending invite already exists' — good. No accidental string mismatch.
Frontend Navbar family-switcher dropdown is rendered conditionally on (families.length > 0) for parents — good. Student role correctly has no switcher (verified).

FamilySettings danger-zone visibility is gated on (members.length === 1 && student_ids.length === 0) which matches DELETE family precondition; intentional behaviour — main agent may want a 'why disabled' tooltip if testid is expected in the doc.
InviteAccept page correctly hides accept button when user is logged in as different email and shows yellow `invite-wrong-email` warning — verified.
